Helpful: The textured surface of these can opener mats increases friction with the lid. Even seniors women, children, people with weaker hands can easily grip and open the lids.

Suitable for Most Jars and Bottles:The jar gripper pads have appropriate size, the square jar gripper measure about 5X5 inch and the round ones measure about 4.92 inch in diameter, conveniently grasp and open most sizes of jars and bottles. Wide Application: In addition to being used as jar grippers to open bottles, cans and sealed containers, rubber bottle openers can also serve as heat insulation coasters, anti-scalding mats or wraps for hot lid and hot handle to avoid scalding your hands and protect the countertop.
